subject: Deploying / Publishing a Shiny App: failed attempt to find temporary /private/var/... files

messages.author: 94d13e337c7d7a78
messages.subject: Deploying / Publishing a Shiny App: failed attempt to find temporary /private/var/... files
parts:
After attempting to publish to shinyapps.io (using the publish button on RStudio), I receive the following output:


========================================
Preparing to deploy document...DONE
Uploading bundle for document: 228462...Error in read.dcf(...) : cannot open the connection
Calls: <Anonymous> ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In as.POSIXlt.POSIXct(x, tz = tz) :
  unknown timezone 'default/America/Los_Angeles'
2: In read.dcf(...) :
  cannot open compressed file '/private/var/folders/2m/lxzpjs4j2sb17qy3wqy9y7nc0000gp/T/RtmpNSGEts/file5f832ac986de/packrat/packrat.lock', probable reason 'No such file or directory'
Execution halted
========================================

I have checked, and indeed there is no file there.  I know that this file path (I have a Mac) is for temporary files.  Also, as you can see, it is attempting to work with the packrat lock file, which shouldn't even be relevant for this work.  How can I tell it to ignore this un-necessary file?

Here is some information, in case any of it is relevant (please let me know if any further is needed):
